subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the wanderer in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>: a woman with long wavy brown hair, hood down, in a long dark indigo coat with a brown shoulder strap, holding a tall wooden staff with a hooked top and a small brass lantern that now holds a captured star. She walks with calm, unhurried steps.
<Subject 2> is the rendering style of <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>: a hand-drawn night landscape built from thick rhythmic curved strokes and engraved contour lines, a swirling indigo and navy sky with spiraling clouds outlined in pale blue and gold, glowing star orbs ringed with halos, and golden wheat drawn stalk by stalk.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing <Subject 1> from behind her right shoulder, right of centre, facing left toward the huge moon on the left, holding up the lantern blazing white-gold in her raised left hand with the staff in her right.
<Picture 2> is the last frame of [Shot 1], showing <Subject 1> from behind, walking away toward the moon at the upper left along a winding trail of glowing gold light through the wheat, the lantern hanging from the staff in her right hand with a warm glow, her long brown hair down her back.

detailed_description:
The target video is a hand-drawn night landscape in motion in <Subject 2>: every stroke of the sky, clouds and wheat keeps its drawn texture as it moves, the clouds and star halos slowly swirling.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The white-gold flare inside the lantern softens into a steady warm glow and the rays fade. She lowers the lantern, hooks it back onto the staff in her right hand and lets it hang at her side. Light spills from the lantern onto the ground at her feet and runs ahead of her through the wheat as a winding ribbon of glowing gold, curving away toward the moon. She steps onto it and walks away along it at a slow, steady pace, her long brown hair and coat moving in the wind, the wheat on both sides lit gold by the trail. The camera drifts left behind her with small amplitude at slow speed and rises slightly, following her from directly behind, the huge moon glowing ahead at the upper left among the spiral clouds and star orbs. The camera is still following her as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.

overall_soundscape:
A low warm hum from the lantern settles under the wind. The trail of light shimmers with a soft crackle as it spreads through the wheat, her footsteps crunch steadily on the ground, and crickets chirp across the field.
